capabilities: Score overall vault health from reference integrity, note connectivity, and attachment integrity
Find orphan notes without incoming references
Identify broken links to notes, headings, blocks, and attachments, including links in YAML properties
Ignore and restore known broken references
Run manual vault scans with paginated results
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; the README documents manual installation from GitHub Releases. Emphasizes that the health score is a diagnostic indicator, not a measure of knowledge quality.
problem: As vaults grow, broken links and unconnected notes accumulate and Obsidian offers no overall diagnostic view of structural health.
summary: Vault structure analyzer that scores vault health, finds orphan notes, and reports broken references from a dashboard.
